# Regional analysis with controls finds no independent association (fixture)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

Across regions, the share of foreign residents is not associated with the recorded crime
rate once we control for population density, age structure, unemployment and the number
of registered suspects per police district. The bivariate association is positive; after
controls it is indistinguishable from zero. Coefficients are reported with standard
errors, and the model is estimated both with and without regional fixed effects.
